title: Borscht Soup
description: A traditional Eastern European beet-based soup with a rich flavor and vibrant color. This recipe is a hearty twist on the classic, incorporating Russian and Ukrainian influences.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped beets, carrots, and cabbage; cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the tomato paste, borscht spice blend, and vegetable broth.
Bring the mixture to a boil; reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream and chopped fresh dill.
Serve hot, garnished with additional fresh dill if desired.
